summary: Wired real worker health and error-spike outcomes into the existing BFF monitor. Added file_worker target probing to DownstreamHealthMonitor for schedulers/consumers/paper-signal-producer, attributed paper-signal-producer artifact_store_missing to Capital loop in BFF/Management truth, verified command_executor _post_json/_get_json integration with record_downstream_outcome, and published Loop 12 controller truth.
acceptance_criteria_validated: The existing monitor consumes functional health or readback for all real schedulers consumers and paper-signal-producer without adding HTTP microservers for file-backed workers
artifact_store_missing is attributed to the Capital loop in BFF and Management truth
production BFF downstream adapters call the existing record_downstream_outcome so the error-spike trigger fires
Loop 12 publishes its own controller truth and no second sentinel monitor or health store is added
